verdict.rationale: Docs confirm embeddable widgets exist (changelog widget, feedback messenger via a typed JS SDK) but nothing explicitly documents a single-script-tag, no-build-step installation flow — the SDK reference (featurebase-js) suggests a client library rather than a plain <script> embed. missing for 10: explicit script-tag snippet/install instructions, confirmation of zero build tooling, and independent developer confirmation of the embed simplicity.
